subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'RAKHI' is coded as 36 - 2 - 22 - 16 - 18 and 'SHALU' is coded as 38 - 16 - 2 - 24 - 42. How will 'MANJU' be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

**Code = positional value × 2**

 
• 'RAKHI' is coded as 36 - 2 - 22 - 16 - 18

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b59105329f19d68a9b0950e6f73be9d19fd3ebeedff900ff500fbe36fd29e2f.png]
